page.layout: One block of verse, set in italic, with a running head above it and a gathering signature at the foot right. Lines are not indented except where a new passage begins (lines 15, 27 and 33), and each indented line starts a new paragraph.

p.i: Surrige te, & puros serua purissima ritus. Te Deus erexit populis insigne theatrum, In quo religio, pietas, rectumque fidesque, Et puri mores, amor & reverentia casti Floreat instaurata: tuum quo nomen in oras Extremas eat, & casti te carmine Vates Æterno celebrent. Ergo rediviva Geneva Illecebris ne dede animum, neu desidè[?] luxu Ocia corrumpant, famæ florentis & illum Splendorem obscurent, quo tu clarissima fulges: Nec vitijs lucem, tibi quam semel attulit ultrò Indulgens Pater, heu, prudens scelerum obrue cæno. Ah precor ah melior sedeat sententia menti Ut solet, & nullis unquam terrebere monstris.

Nî facias sperato Dei miseranda furorem Protinus, & cunctis subitos de partibus hostes, Qui male grati animi ferro te & vindice flamma Arguerint coram indocales, teque omnia cogent Sæva pati, & diris servitum Regibus ire. Omnia sperato contraria, si semel ausis Excussisse Deum, & leges temerare sacratas. Quò maiore Deus te libertate beauit Largus opum, quibus te cumulatam servat & auget, Hoc magè funestam spera lachrymosa[?] ruinam, Si semel à Christo defeceris: ecce Geneva In præceps funesta rues, miseranda Geneva.

Si Deus haud Urbíque suæ Templóque pepercit Iratus; totiesque sui tam dira tulerunt Supplicia, & meritas soluerunt sanguine pœnas; Græcia si & Nili populus, gentesque profanæ: Qua nostrum precor ille manu crimenque nefasque Arguerit vindex? quo te precor arguet ore?
Non sua terribilis vindictæ fulmina durus Præcipitat, pœnamque statim de fontibus Ultor

page.notes: Printed text runs in italic throughout. Corrections to the printed letters: the u in "rediuiua", "reuerentia", "vnquam" and "vltrò" read as v or u according to rule 5 (for example "rediviva", "reverentia", "unquam", "ultrò", "Ultor", "Urbíque"). "sceleruum" is printed as "scelerum". "Geneua" is printed as "Geneva". Doubtful readings: "desidè[?]" (the printed word after "neu" is hard to read), and "lachrymosa[?]" (the printed letters are unclear). The "Nî" in line 15 keeps its printed circumflex. No page number is printed. The gathering mark "β." sits at the foot right of centre.
